look: KarmaLab identity: black canvas, portraits in rounded cards on hairline borders, pink for what should be read, Space Grotesk light at one text size, separate text slides when there is a lot to say; calm editorial motion, grids that fill one by one.

scenes.name: Une personne
scenes.desc: Sixteen 'person' portraits appear one by one into a 4x4 grid.

scenes.name: Un.e médecin
scenes.desc: The doctor grid replaces the first, portraits arriving quickly.

scenes.name: Un.e parent.e
scenes.desc: The parent grid fills in; who does it imagine.

scenes.name: Visages récurrents
scenes.desc: Successive zooms on portraits from the three series, faces framed in pink.

scenes.name: Les données
scenes.desc: A mosaic of images scrolls and grows to fill the screen.

scenes.name: Des milliards d'images
scenes.desc: Text slide: how image AI learns.

scenes.name: D'où viennent les images
scenes.desc: Web pages, photos and captions scroll; a pink line rises and closes over them, then opens downward and reveals the text about hidden training data. Source line.

scenes.name: Sur Internet
scenes.desc: A giant mosaic of images from many worlds, progressively sorted into categories.

scenes.name: 6 milliards
scenes.desc: Text slide: LAION-5B, what it contains, rights. Source line.

scenes.name: Ce qui se répète
scenes.desc: Some images repeat in the mosaic, others are rare.

scenes.name: Notre société
scenes.desc: Text slide: the data comes from our society.

scenes.name: Stéréotypes
scenes.desc: Portraits from the three series regroup by shared traits.

scenes.name: Au quotidien
scenes.desc: The same face in a textbook, an ad, a recruitment poster; then it multiplies.

scenes.name: La norme
scenes.desc: Text slide: seeing the same images makes them the norm.

scenes.name: Enquêter
scenes.desc: One 16-portrait grid regroups; empty slots for what is missing.

scenes.name: Un début d'enquête
scenes.desc: Text slide: compare, count, look for what is missing.

scenes.name: Voir les choix
scenes.desc: One portrait breaks into pixels then images, which reassemble into the first grid cell; the grid restarts.
